paper_title: Laboratory Constraints on the Neutron-Spin Coupling of feV-scale Axions
notes: K-3He co-magnetometer re-analysis of ~40 days of data (originally Ref [9]) with a frequency-domain stochastic-axion likelihood. Headline result (abstract, Sec IV, Fig 5): median 95% upper limit on the neutron-spin coupling g_aNN < 2.4e-10 GeV^-1 (minimum median at 0.36 Hz) for axion masses 0.4-4 feV. The paper's Lagrangian Eq (1) is L = g_aNN N-bar gamma^mu gamma_5 N d_mu a with g_aNN in GeV^-1, i.e. the g in GeV^-1 form, so per the 2m_N rule g_an = 2 m_n g_aNN = 2 x 0.9396 GeV x 2.4e-10 GeV^-1 = 4.51e-10 (dimensionless). Reported as a flat limit over the stated 0.4-4 feV range (0.4 feV = 4e-16 eV, 4 feV = 4e-15 eV; 1 feV ~ 0.24 Hz). The experimental orange curve in Fig 5 is highly spiky; the headline/quoted number is the flat median 95% UL, which is what is reported here. Assumes all local dark matter is axions at rho_DM ~ 0.3 GeV/cm^3 (Ref [65]); limit scales with density, do not rescale.
